events.question: What was our paid revenue in September 2026, net of refunds?

intent.status: Found invoices and organizations for September revenue

events.label: Found invoices and organizations for September revenue

plan.headline: Paid invoice revenue for September 2026, excluding test orgs, with a daily trend and a plan-tier breakdown.

metrics.title: Paid revenue, Sept 2026
metrics.description: Sum of amount_cents (shown in USD) for invoices with status 'paid' whose paid_at falls in the selected period. Void invoices are excluded. The schema has no refund records, so this is gross paid revenue.

metrics.title: Daily paid revenue
metrics.description: Paid invoice revenue per day across the selected period, bucketed by paid_at in the chosen timezone.

metrics.title: Revenue by plan tier
metrics.description: Paid invoice revenue in the selected period grouped by the tier of the plan on the invoice's subscription. Subscriptions with no plan are grouped as unknown.

assumptions.label: Period
assumptions.rationale: September 2026 as asked, with inclusive start and end dates.

assumptions.label: Reporting timezone
assumptions.rationale: Determines which day a payment falls on near month boundaries. UTC is the default since no company timezone is given.

assumptions.label: Exclude test orgs
assumptions.rationale: The data dictionary says test, demo and load-test tenants should be excluded from business metrics.

assumptions.label: Revenue date basis
assumptions.rationale: Paid revenue is counted when cash is received (paid_at), not when the invoice was issued.

events.sql:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT i.amount_cents,
    CASE WHEN :revenue_date_basis::text = 'issued_at' THEN i.issued_at ELSE i.paid_at END AS rev_ts
  FROM northwind.invoices i
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = i.org_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND i.paid_at IS NOT NULL
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents) FILTER (WHERE rev_ts >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AND rev_ts < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text), 0) / 100.0, 2) AS value,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents) FILTER (WHERE rev_ts >= (:date_range_prev_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AND rev_ts < (:date_range_prev_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text), 0) / 100.0, 2) AS previous_value
FROM inv
events.explanation: Sums amount_cents of paid invoices (excluding test orgs if set) whose chosen date basis falls in the period in the reporting timezone, in dollars, with the previous period for comparison; no refund data exists so it is gross.

events.sql:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT i.amount_cents,
    CASE WHEN :revenue_date_basis::text = 'issued_at' THEN i.issued_at ELSE i.paid_at END AS rev_ts
  FROM northwind.invoices i
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = i.org_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND i.paid_at IS NOT NULL
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
),
daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', rev_ts AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text)::date AS day,
    SUM(amount_cents) AS cents
  FROM inv
  WHERE rev_ts >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
    AND rev_ts < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text
  GROUP BY 1
),
days AS (
  SELECT generate_series(:date_range_start::date, (:date_range_end::date - 1), interval '1 day')::date AS day
)
SELECT d.day AS x,
  ROUND(COALESCE(dl.cents, 0) / 100.0, 2) AS y
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN daily dl ON dl.day = d.day
ORDER BY d.day
events.explanation: Sums paid invoice amounts per day in the chosen timezone (by paid_at or issued_at per the basis assumption), excluding test orgs when set, and fills zero-revenue days.

events.sql:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.amount_cents, i.subscription_id
  FROM northwind.invoices i
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = i.org_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)
    AND (CASE WHEN :revenue_date_basis::text = 'issued_at' THEN i.issued_at ELSE i.paid_at END) >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
    AND (CASE WHEN :revenue_date_basis::text = 'issued_at' THEN i.issued_at ELSE i.paid_at END) < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text
)
SELECT COALESCE(p.tier, 'unknown') AS label,
       round(sum(inv.amount_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS value
FROM inv
JOIN northwind.subscriptions s ON s.id = inv.subscription_id
LEFT JOIN northwind.plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(p.tier, 'unknown')
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 20
events.explanation: Sums paid invoices in the period (by the chosen date basis and timezone, excluding test orgs if set), grouped by the plan tier of each invoice's subscription, with missing plans shown as unknown.

review.summary: The query correctly sums paid, non-test invoices by paid_at in September 2026 (UTC), but the schema has no refund records, so this is gross paid revenue rather than the net-of-refunds figure you asked for.

issues.message: The question asks for revenue net of refunds, but northwind has no refund table or status, so SUM(invoices.amount_cents) is gross. Label the KPI as gross paid revenue so users do not read it as net.

previous_value uses date_range_prev_start/end (2026-08-02 to 2026-09-01), a 30-day window rather than calendar August. Label it 'prior 30 days' or use 2026-08-01 to 2026-09-01 for a month-over-month comparison.
